utilization_measurement.reason: The legacy report recorded parent process CPU time and verification elapsed time, but not child worker PIDs or child CPU time.

implementation_finding.detail: Each preparation thread submits one verification job and immediately waits on future.result(), so verification is bounded by the preparation threads rather than being an independent streaming pipeline.

state_mismatch_diagnostic.classification: CUDA floating-point kernel nondeterminism explains the legacy exact-hash mismatch under the tested configuration; input ordering and indexed assembly were not the cause.

next_action: Use deterministic CUDA settings for state-comparison diagnostics and evaluate SSRE as an independent CPU useful-work pipeline rather than as a duplicate tensor-delivery path.
